pages.text: Show your bottles off: a $(item)Wine Rack$() holds six lying down, a $(item)Bottle Shelf$() six standing, a $(item)Wine Display$() three along its shelves. Every spirit has its own bottle. Hoppers fill and empty them, and a comparator reads how full they are.
